d: Carli the vegetarian finds herself in the middle of a hunting society house party, Dillon fails at speed dating and the bad waiter on Jake's date looks like Jersey Shore's Vinny.

Janelle is set up with a Hollywood player and has to deal with his psycho ex, Ashley wipes out on her blind date with a dim-witted surfer, while Mike goes down in flames when his date refuses to put out her cigarette.
Manny is tired of waiting for Mack to make the first move, so it's she makes her own. James wants to try to create a relationship with his friend, Sam.
John is scared to tell his best friend Leah his true feeings. Clarissa is looking to create a relationship with her best friend and bandmate Joe.
Day feels its time to tell her BF Curtis she likes him.  Derian feels that co-worker Kelsey has the potential to be more than friends.

The battle between Dario and Layton over Ashley intensifies.  Ellie turns her attention towards Nathan but Nathan is convinced that Christina is his perfect match.  For Christina, the pressure of being the 11th girl is too much.

Despite not being a match, Nathan explodes when Christina returns to Brandon.  With just two Matchup Ceremonies left, Ashley's indecision between Layton and Dario could keep the house from winning it all.
The house is faced with the final matchup ceremony and one switch to make.  While the Truth Booth delivers some much needed answers, the question of the 11th girl puts the $1million in jeopardy.
21 castmates reunite as host, Ryan Devlin, finds out if love lasted outside of Puerto Rico. All of the explosive drama that happened, after the final matchup ceremony lights went down, is revealed.
Georgia and Callum's relationship is put to the test when the Ex they dreaded the most shows up.  Tensions flare over La Demi's latest love interest. A romantic Hot Date is awarded.
A shocking Sauna of Secrets means that the Singles have to watch their back at the Ice Ceremony.  Allie and Niall's on-again-off-again relationship leaves Allie on shaky ground.
A perfect date turns into a perfect nightmare for one couple. Niall is met with serious competition for Allie's affection. Marlon and La Demi struggle to figure out their situation-ship.

Georgia and Callum face their harshest critics. Marlon is caught between a rock and a hot place when an Ex arrives that jeopardizes his relationship with La Demi. The Ice Ceremony takes an unexpected turn.
Crystal gets set up with a sketchy artist, Dora dates a glee club nerd, and Pilar hangs out with the lead singer of a lame metal band
